    AI Overview
    The Masters Tournament is played annually at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia, USA. As one of the four major championships in men's professional golf, it is the only major held at the same venue every year, typically in early April. 
    Key Details About the Venue: 
    • Location: Augusta, Georgia, United States.
    • Course: Augusta National Golf Club, a private course designed by Bobby Jones and Alister MacKenzie.
    • Tradition: The tournament has been held at this location annually since its inception in 1934
      .
    • Features: Famous for its immaculate conditions, blooming azaleas, and challenging holes known as "Amen Corner" (holes 11, 12, and 13). 
    Unlike other major tournaments that rotate locations, the Masters has always been played at Augusta National.

    People also ask
    How much is a ticket to the Masters?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    For the 2026 Masters, official tickets purchased via the Masters ticket lottery cost $125–$150 for practice rounds and $160 per tournament day. However, tickets on the secondary resale market (like StubHub or Vivid Seats) often cost over $2,000 to over $10,000 per day. 
    Official Ticket Prices (2026 Tournament) 
    • Practice Rounds (Mon-Tue): $125
    • Par 3 Contest (Wednesday): $150
    • Tournament Days (Thu-Sun): $160
    • Weekly Badge: $525 
    Key Details for Tickets 
    • Authorized Source: The only official, reliable source is the official Masters ticket lottery.
    • Lottery Application: Applications for the 2027 tournament open from June 1-20, 2026.
    • Resale Risk: While tickets appear on resale sites for thousands, Augusta National strictly bans unauthorized resale and may cancel tickets found on the secondary market.
    • Merch/Food: Food is famously affordable ($1.50–$6), but merchandise is a major expense for many attendees. 
    Resale Market Reality 
    • Single-day tickets for the 2026 tournament on third-party sites frequently reached over $6,000, with some reaching as high as $10,000-$20,000+ per day, according to reports.
